description.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Stunned</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn(s)</color>.
description.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>スタン</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間付与する。
description.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color> 확률로 대상을 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>스턴</color> 상태로 만듭니다.
description.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>的几率使目标陷入<color=#28d9ed>晕眩</color>状态，持续<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。

description.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>25%</color> chance to reduce the target's <color=#28d9ed>Priority Gauge</color> by <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>.
description.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>25%</color>の確率で対象の<color=#28d9ed>行動ゲージ</color>を<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>DOWNさせる。
description.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>25%</color> 확률로 대상의 <color=#28d9ed>행동 게이지</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>10%</color>를 감소시킵니다.
description.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>25%</color>的几率使目标的<color=#28d9ed>行动值</color>降低<color=#28d9ed>10%</color>。

description.en:
(Passive Effect)
<color=#ffd732>Upon death, grants 50 Action Points and 4 Chain Points for each enemy.</color>

Grants <color=#28d9ed>Immunity</color> for <color=#28d9ed>1 turn(s)</color> at the start of battle.
description.jp:
(パッシブ効果)
<color=#ffd732>倒れた時、敵全体にAPを50、CPを4獲得させる。</color>

戦闘開始時、自分に<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1ターン</color>の間付与する。
description.kr:
(패시브 효과)
<color=#ffd732>사망 시 적 한 명당 AP 50, CP 4 씩 회복시킵니다.</color>

전투 시작 시 <color=#28d9ed>1턴</color> 동안 <color=#28d9ed>면역</color> 상태가 됩니다.
description.zh:
(被动效果)
<color=#ffd732>死亡时，使每个敌人的AP恢复50、CP恢复4。</color>

战斗开始时，获得<color=#28d9ed>免疫</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>1回合</color>。
